title: MJ12 memos reference CIC involvement at Roswell

tellings.quote: Leaked MJ12 memos from the 1940s reference CIC involvement in UFO investigations, including Roswell.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that leaked memos from the 1940s, known as the MJ12 papers and said to come from a secret group handling UFO matters, mention the CIC, a US Army counterintelligence unit, taking part in UFO investigations. He says this includes Roswell, New Mexico, where a crashed object is said to have been recovered in 1947, which would tie military intelligence directly to that case if the memos are real.
